name: Spatially Partitioned Shear-Warp Method
aliases: 空間分割シアーワープ法
definition: A parallel volume rendering method that partitions the volume into subvolumes, generates local base plane images (sheared images) for each subvolume in parallel, composites these images using a binary tree (compositing tree) to handle occlusion/priority, and finally applies warping to correct distortion.
summary: The Spatially Partitioned Shear-Warp Method is a parallel volume rendering technique that partitions 3D data into sub-volumes for independent rendering and composites results via a binary tree, enabling view-independent partitioning and optimized network transfer for distributed clusters.
